name: EXM_TRIPS
description: This table contains general information about business trips associated with travel itineraries, cash advance requests and expense reports.

columns.name: TRIP_ID
columns.description: Unique Identifier for a trip.

columns.name: PERSON_ID
columns.description: Person taking trip.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: TRIP_NAME
columns.description: Name of this trip.

columns.name: LOCATION
columns.description: Destination location of trip. For multi-destination trips, destination location is concatenation of initial and final destinations.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Date when this trip starts.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: Date when this trip ends.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Preferred currency code of user.

columns.name: ESTIMATED_TOTAL
columns.description: Estimated total expense of  trip in user's preferred currency.

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status of trip, such as Active, Canceled, Completed.

columns.name: UPDATED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether this trip was updated.

columns.name: CASH_ADVANCE_ADDED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether cash advance was added to trip.
